popCulture.title: Oedipus Rex
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Sophocles' tragedy keeps the Theban cycle's core wound on every modern stage — the king who solves the riddle and blinds himself.

popCulture.title: Antigone
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Antigone's defiance of Creon became the cycle's political afterlife — burial rights against the state, restaged from Anouilh to every protest era.
